verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an actual llms.txt file is live at pipedream.com/llms.txt with structured agent-oriented content describing Connect, MCP servers, and API tooling, and Pipedream also publishes extensive agent-oriented docs (MCP developer docs, REST API, CLI reference) that an agent could be pointed at.
